t: You're at Maida Vale station, on the Bakerloo line between Kilburn Park and Warwick Avenue, in fare zone 2. The architect Stanley Heaps designed it. Heaps was an English architect who was responsible for a number of stations on the London Underground. He also designed train depots, and bus and trolleybus garages, for London Transport. So this station is one piece of a much larger body of transport architecture across the network.
